fields.title: Large Pothole on Wyandotte St E
fields.description: A significant pothole approximately 40cm wide and 15cm deep near the intersection of Wyandotte and Gladstone. Vehicles swerving to avoid it are creating a secondary hazard.

fields.title: Missing Stop Sign at Tecumseh & Pillette
fields.description: The stop sign at the south-east corner of Tecumseh Rd E and Pillette Rd is completely missing. Very dangerous for cross-traffic especially during evening hours.

fields.title: Street Light Out — Three Consecutive Blocks on Walker Rd
fields.description: Three consecutive street lights are out on Walker Rd between Seminole and Richmond. The stretch is completely dark at night, posing safety risks to pedestrians and cyclists.
fields.street: Walker Rd between Seminole and Richmond

fields.title: Road Sinkhole Developing on Lauzon Pkwy
fields.description: A sinkhole approximately 1m wide is forming in the right lane of Lauzon Pkwy near Riverside Dr. The asphalt has cracked and is starting to collapse inward.
fields.street: Lauzon Pkwy near Riverside Dr E

fields.title: Debris Blocking Bike Lane on University Ave W
fields.description: Large chunks of concrete and gravel debris are scattered across the bike lane on University Ave W near Sunset Ave. Cyclists are forced into traffic.
fields.street: University Ave W near Sunset Ave

fields.title: Standing Water / Flooding at Danforth & Main St
fields.description: After every rain event, the intersection at Danforth Ave and Main St floods with standing water 20–30cm deep. Vehicles have stalled and pedestrians cannot cross safely.

fields.title: Massive Pothole on Queen St E near Broadview
fields.description: A pothole spanning nearly the full right lane on Queen St E just west of Broadview Ave. Already caused two flat tires that I am aware of this week.
fields.street: Queen St E near Broadview Ave

fields.title: Damaged Guardrail on Gardiner Expressway Ramp
fields.description: The guardrail on the Spadina Ave on-ramp to the westbound Gardiner Expressway has significant damage — several sections bent outward, offering minimal protection.
fields.street: Spadina Ave on-ramp to Gardiner Expressway WB

fields.title: Small Pothole — Wyandotte St E (duplicate test)
fields.description: Another pothole near Wyandotte and Gladstone intersection — slightly south of the existing report. Unsure if it is the same one.
fields.street: Wyandotte St E near Gladstone Ave

fields.title: Fixed: Cracked Sidewalk on Ouellette Ave
fields.description: Large crack in the sidewalk on Ouellette Ave between Park and Elliott. Several pedestrians have tripped. Now repaired.
fields.street: Ouellette Ave between Park St and Elliott St
